meta.title: The Update Tree
meta.subtitle: Three root groups, three player loop phases, and the netcode groups at the positions their attributes actually give them

views.label: Three roots, three phases
views.note: These three are created in every world whether or not anything is put in them, and each is appended to a different player loop phase.

views.label: The OrderFirst bucket
views.note: Four groups pin themselves to the front of simulation, then order among themselves with UpdateBefore.

views.label: Prediction runs before fixed step
views.note: There are two fixed-step groups. The one inside prediction is the one that replays; the outer one does not.

views.label: Where an unpinned system lands
views.note: No attribute at all means simulation, in the middle, after everything that pinned itself first.

cards.title: The surprise that reorders your mental model
items: Prediction is not somewhere after fixed step; it declares UpdateBefore fixed step
So the replay loop finishes before the ordinary fixed step has run once
Netcode adds a second fixed step of its own, pinned first inside prediction · GhostPredictionSystemGroup.cs:195
Physics you want rolled back must go in that one, not in the outer fixed step

cards.title: Three roots, and only three
items: Initialization, simulation and presentation are created before any of your systems · DefaultWorldInitialization.cs:314
Everything else on this map is a child that asked to be there
Presentation is the only root that overrides what its children default to · DefaultWorld.cs:768
Simulation declares nothing, which is why an unfiltered system lands in every game world

cards.title: What this map deliberately leaves out
items: The begin and end command buffer systems that bracket every group
VariableRateSimulationSystemGroup and LateSimulationSystemGroup, both real, both rarely load-bearing
The command send and receive groups, which sit inside ghost simulation and network receive
BovineLabs adds several more; the mechanism for reading their position is the same four attributes
